text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa has been feeling out of
sorts
recently, so I decide to take her to
a shrine to try
and lift her mood.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Hello. I never imagined running into you
here.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I've always understood Nakayama
as one to
believe more in herself than
the divine.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
That's true. I'm not really here to pray,
more to
just kinda say hi.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Although, I do believe in the divine, you
know?
Miracles, fate, lucky chances, and
the like.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It's why I have to keep in touch, if you
catch my
drift.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Can't have them turning their back on
me if things
suddenly go way south.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I see. It makes perfect sense, actually,
the thrill of
rolling dice is all about luck.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh... You get it. I knew you were one of
the cool
ones.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: All right, well, I'm gonna go say hi.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama and I stand next to each
other.
Thinking I feel another presence, I
look over and
see Eishin Flash praying
with us.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: So, you came to pray too.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No. I just came here for a change of
pace, but
when I saw you two up here, I
couldn't help but
want to join.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The proper way to pray is to bow twice,
clap
twice, and then bow once more. I
think your
gestures were a little
haphazard...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
But I could tell your feelings were
sincere.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for this opportunity. I was
able to
experience the Japanese sense
of reverence.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Huh? What do we deserve a thanks for?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Sheesh... What a weirdo.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it was Eishin Flash's gratefulness
or the
experience of us three praying
together, but
Nakayama Festa seems to
be feeling much better
now!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Oh... I'm sorry. Are you out of time?
Please go
ahead and pray.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hm? Are you not going in?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No. I just came here for a change of
pace. I'm
going to hang around a little
more. I'll do a prayer
before I leave,
though.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I get it. This place is really peaceful. I
like to
come and unwind too.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Good idea.
choice_data_list: じゃあ、ゆっくりしていこうか
choice_data_list_en: Then shall we take our time?

text_block_list.name: Flashy Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
No waaay! My ice cream's gonna melt! Is
there
really nowhere to sit around here?

text_block_list.name: Flashy Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Let's sit on that rock! Oh em gee! The
bear's face
is super hilarious when it's
melting!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Is this because I put off going to
say hi?
They're about to piss me off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's become difficult to pray or relax with
all the
sudden noise. Nakayama Festa is
unable to lift
her mood.
